title: Schema for the record links data file: how two records of any types relate, read both ways (see docs/data-model.md)

from_type.description: The collection of the record the link is from.

from_id.description: The record's id in that collection.

to_type.description: The collection of the record the link is to.

to_id.description: The record's id in that collection.

relation.description: How the from record relates to the to record. figure-of: the miniature stands for the deployment card or hero. document-for: the document was published for the source (not in its box). requires: the record can only be played with the source. expands: the record adds to the source.

reverse_relation.description: The same link read from the to record: has-figure, has-document, required-by, expanded-by.

oneOf.description: A miniature and the deployment cards and hero it stands for.
A document published for a source, but not in its box.
A record (a product, a mission, ...) that can only be played with a source.
A record that adds to a source.
